articles.title: Pope Leo's First US Election Vote Sparks Political Frenzy; Internet Debates His Party Allegiance
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV has made history by becoming the first pontiff to vote in a US election, submitting his mail-in ballot in Chicago ahead of the midterms. The Vatican confirmed the historic move, saying the Pope believes citizens have both the right and duty to participate in democratic processes. But while his vote has grabbed headlines, one big question remains unanswered: did the first American Pope back the Democrats or Republicans? Social media is buzzing with speculation, but his political choice remains private.

articles.title: ‘HE'S PUKING ALL OVER!’: Trump Mocks James Talarico As ‘Vegan’, Jokes About Forced Meat-Eating
articles.description: US President Donald Trump mocked Texas Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico during a rally in South Carolina, repeatedly calling him a vegan and claiming he opposed meat, oil and guns. Trump joked that Talarico had begun attending barbecues for political reasons, making exaggerated remarks about being forced to eat meat and vomiting backstage. He also predicted that Talarico would return to his supposed vegan lifestyle after the election, regardless of the result. The remarks were part of Trump's broader criticism of Democratic candidates ahead of the midterms. The claims about Talarico's diet and positions were Trump's assertions, not independently established facts.
